name: Squeeze then trend-confirmed breakout (15m)
rationale: A 15m bandwidth squeeze that coincides with a RISING ADX marks a coiled range that is beginning to trend — the directional energy is building before the band fully expands. Entering here catches the transition from range to trend at its earliest confirmable point. The other side is the range-scalper still fading the boundaries as the regime flips underneath them. Edge persists because the compression-to-trend transition is a recurring volatility-cycle event. Distinct from the squeeze+range_position spec: the confirmation is trend STRENGTH (ADX), not position in the range. Disconfirmer: exits when ADX falls back below the exit floor (the coil failed to trend) or the stop fires.
catalyst: volatility squeeze with a strengthening trend reading
